description: Audit a list of fees: annualize each one (monthly x12), total the yearly cost and monthly average, and flag charges above the typical US range for their category, duplicate names and one-time fees of $30+ worth disputing. Use when the user lists fees to review. For a multi-year projection use annual_cost; for typical ranges alone use benchmark_fees.

fees.description: Non-empty list of fees to audit, each {name, amount, frequency, category?}

amount.description: Amount per charge in USD, greater than 0, e.g. 38 or 15.99 (for monthly fees, the monthly amount)

category.description: Optional benchmark category key (case-insensitive; spaces/hyphens become underscores). One of: bank_overdraft, bank_monthly_maintenance, atm_out_of_network, late_payment, gym_membership_monthly, streaming_monthly, airline_checked_bag, airline_seat_fee, ticket_convenience, rental_application, subscription_app_monthly, delivery_fee, airline_change_fee, hotel_resort_fee. Unknown keys are ignored for benchmarking and listed in audit_fees' note.

frequency.description: How often the fee is charged: 'monthly' (x12 per year), 'annual' or 'one-time'

name.description: Fee label as it appears on the statement, e.g. 'Overdraft fee' or 'Netflix'

name: audit_fees

currency.description: Currency of all amounts; always USD

fees.description: One audited row per input fee, in input order

amount.description: Amount per charge, USD, rounded to cents

annualized.description: Yearly cost of this fee, USD (monthly x12; annual and one-time as-is)

flags.description: Problem flags; empty when none apply

flagged_count.description: Number of fees with at least one flag

note.description: Plain-language summary of the audit result; lists any unknown category keys that were ignored

total_annual.description: Sum of all annualized fees, USD

title: Audit fees
